title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop by creating a rectangle with four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0422, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0422, 0.0) and ends at (0.0422, 0.0422). The third line starts at (0.0422, 0.0422) and ends at (0.0, 0.0422). The fourth line completes the rectangle by starting at (0.0, 0.0422) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). In the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0211, 0.0211) with a radius of 0.0042. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0422 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector set to zero. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a 3D model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This boolean operation will create a new solid body with a length of 0.0422 units, a width of 0.0422 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

# Add a circle in the sketch
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0211, 0.0211).circle(0.0042)

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Square post with a small through-hole in the center (along Z axis)

import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
size = 0.0422
length = 0.75
chamfer = 0.002
hole_dia = 0.008

# Square bar with chamfered vertical edges
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(size, size, length, centered=(True, True, False))

# Chamfer the four long vertical edges (visible in top view and isometric)
r = r.edges("|Z").chamfer(chamfer)

# Central through-hole along the full length (visible in the top view)
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane().hole(hole_dia)
